email.subject: An Egypt special for The Travel Diaries
paragraphs: The Travel Diaries already makes destination specials, from Queensland to Saudi Arabia. Egypt could be a natural next one.

One idea: an episode recorded on location, with the guest of your choosing, at Giza at first light, at the Grand Egyptian Museum, or on the Nile between Luxor and Aswan. NOYA, a UK-based concierge and destination management company specialising in Egypt, would handle locations, permissions, stays and movement on the ground.
Would it be worth a short call to see if it fits your plans for next year?
